key_risk: Rapid solar growth approaching inflection. PPA prices high but capture declining. Tariff/policy uncertainty.
key_opportunity: Largest DC market in world. 30 GW DC growth by 2030. Microsoft TMI nuclear doesn't cover gap. Capacity market pays $666/MW-day.
hedge_quality: Excellent: hyperscaler demand vastly exceeds supply. Google+MSFT need local hourly clean. Meta/Amazon need volume for annual claims.

key_risk: Battery supply chain. Higher capex. Interconnection delays (170GW queue).
key_opportunity: PJM capacity auction shortfall (6.6 GW in 2025). Storage gets capacity payments. Shaped product commands premium.
hedge_quality: Excellent: premium product in undersupplied market.

key_risk: Siting constraints. Slower permitting. Western PJM congestion.
key_opportunity: Less cannibalization than solar. Nighttime generation complements solar. Data center load is 24/7.
hedge_quality: Good: fills nighttime gap that solar can't.

key_risk: Fastest cannibalization trajectory outside CAISO. No capacity market = merchant risk. Negative pricing accelerating.
key_opportunity: Largest DC queue in US (233 GW). Fastest growing market. xAI Memphis. Battery arbitrage $150+/kW-yr.
hedge_quality: Good: massive demand but price floor uncertain without capacity market.

key_risk: No capacity market means storage value is pure arbitrage. OBBBA policy risk.
key_opportunity: Behind-meter demand from DCs. 8.8 GW new gas doesn't cover need. Wind curtailment creates storage charging windows.
hedge_quality: Very Good: co-location with DC = guaranteed offtake.

key_risk: Already deeply cannibalized. SPP wind flooding ERCOT via DC ties. Congestion.
key_opportunity: Cheap RECs for consequential buyers (Meta/Amazon). New 765kV Permian line could improve.
hedge_quality: Moderate: depends on consequential accounting surviving. If hourly wins, ERCOT wind RECs worthless for claims.

key_risk: Rapid solar growth (4x since 2023). MISO is where solar cannibalization hits next. Limited storage today.
key_opportunity: Meta/Amazon primary REC procurement market. Cheap land/interconnection. If consequential accounting survives = strong demand floor.
hedge_quality: Good but conditional: EFP survival is key. If hourly accounting mandatory, MISO unbundled RECs lose value.

key_risk: Already well-supplied. Cheap RECs ($1-5/MWh). Wind penetration high. Diminishing value.
key_opportunity: Consequential buyers need cheapest possible emissions reduction. MISO wind = lowest $/tCO2 avoided.
hedge_quality: Poor-Moderate: oversupplied. New wind competes against existing cheap fleet.

key_risk: Small market. Limited DC presence. Transmission constrained. Follows MISO trajectory.
key_opportunity: Cheapest wholesale power. If DC growth reaches SPP = strong upside. Greenfield opportunity.
hedge_quality: Poor: very limited hyperscaler presence. Mostly speculative.

key_risk: Worst wind capture in US. Extreme congestion. Oversupplied.
key_opportunity: Only value is cheapest RECs in country for consequential buyers. Limited.

key_risk: <30% capture rate. 13% negative-price hours. Standalone solar is unbankable.
key_opportunity: 98% of queue is paired with storage. Market has already adapted. Shaped solar still valuable.
hedge_quality: Moderate: demand exists but must be storage-paired. Standalone worthless.

key_risk: Storage saturation beginning. 13 GW batteries. Diminishing arbitrage. Need longer duration.
key_opportunity: Google HQ demand. High PPA prices = high revenue. CPUC mandate driving procurement. Geothermal competition.
hedge_quality: Good: constrained market with willing buyers.

key_risk: Permitting very difficult. Small market. High costs. Moratorium risk.
key_opportunity: Highest PPA prices in US. Minimal cannibalization through 2030. Financial DC anchor tenants.
hedge_quality: Good: undersupplied premium market but hard to build.

key_risk: Smallest market. Highest costs. Limited land. Permitting challenges.
key_opportunity: Premium pricing. No cannibalization risk. Offshore wind pipeline creates complementary value.
hedge_quality: Moderate: small but premium. Hard to scale.
